integrity: The known Singleton bound and linear existence are treated as prior work. The new claim is the complete arbitrary-code equality census, affine/nonlinear split, and orbit classification. Two independent distance computations and two independent exact clique enumerations reconstruct the finite result from definitions.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification for binary cyclic length six, window size three, and minimum three-symbol distance six. No claim is made for other lengths, alphabets, window sizes, noncyclic models, or other minimum distances.
title: Complete equality census for the binary length-six three-symbol MDS boundary
